title: Foundational Principles
description: The complete ontological foundation of Spatial Displacement Theory, establishing four irreducible primitives from which all physical phenomena emerge.

overview.abstract: This foundational document establishes the four irreducible primitives of physical reality: SPACE (Spation), MATTER (Displacement), MOVEMENT (Shunt Dynamics), and NOW (Time Emergence). These primitives are shown to be necessary and sufficient for a complete description of physical reality, with the Cosmic Microwave Background providing the fundamental source of all pressure and energy.
keyPoints: Four irreducible primitives form the foundation of all physics
CMB provides the fundamental pressure and energy source
All physical quantities emerge from geometric interactions
Mass and gravitational constant are derived, not fundamental
Force hierarchy emerges from pressure spread across steradians

keyConcepts.name: Four Irreducible Primitives
keyConcepts.description: The fundamental building blocks of physical reality: SPACE (Spation), MATTER (Displacement), MOVEMENT (Shunt Dynamics), and NOW (Time Emergence).
keyConcepts.importance: These four primitives are necessary and sufficient for describing all physical phenomena without additional assumptions beyond CMB influx.

keyConcepts.name: Spation
keyConcepts.description: An incompressible, inviscid superfluid medium filling all space continuously, supporting pressure propagation at speed c.
keyConcepts.importance: Provides the medium through which all forces and interactions occur, with bulk modulus K_bulk = 4.6 × 10^113 Pa.

keyConcepts.name: Displacement
keyConcepts.description: Geometric structures that exclude spation volume, creating regions where spation cannot exist and forming toroidal vortices.
keyConcepts.importance: Matter is not point particles with intrinsic properties but geometric displacement structures that modify pressure fields.

keyConcepts.name: Shunt Dynamics
keyConcepts.description: Discrete micro-collisions between matter boundaries and spation, consisting of resistance, recoil, and transference phases.
keyConcepts.importance: All forces, energy, and momentum emerge from shunt events. Energy per shunt = hν, force = ν⟨Δp⟩.

keyConcepts.name: Time Emergence
keyConcepts.description: Time as the count of shunt events divided by shunt frequency, not a fundamental dimension.
keyConcepts.importance: Time emerges from counting oscillations rather than being a fundamental flow. t = N_shunts/ν.

keyConcepts.name: CMB as Fundamental Source
keyConcepts.description: The Cosmic Microwave Background provides continuous EM radiation influx that establishes and maintains all pressure fields.
keyConcepts.importance: Completes the causal chain: CMB → Pressure → Compression → Fusion → Stellar Output → Planetary Energy → All physical processes.

keyConcepts.name: Force Hierarchy
keyConcepts.description: Forces scale from 1/r³ at small scales to 1/r² at large scales as pressure spreads across steradians.
keyConcepts.importance: Resolves the vacuum catastrophe by recognizing that pressure density decreases with distance, not remaining uniformly dense.

derivations.name: Master Energy Transfer Equation
derivations.description: Energy transfer rate from CMB pressure field through geometric coupling factors.
steps: Energy transfer rate = ∫_boundary Π(r) v · dA
For effective capture area: Ė = P_∞ A_eff Γ κ (1-η)
Where Γ = v_poloidal/c, κ = 1/r_minor, η = slip factor

derivations.name: Mass as Derived Quantity
derivations.description: Mass emerges from displacement volume and spation properties, not as a fundamental constant.

derivations.name: Gravitational Constant as Derived
derivations.description: G emerges from spation properties and displacement geometry, not as a fundamental constant.
steps: Pressure gradient from displacement: dΠ/dr = κ V_disp K_bulk/(2π r³)
Substitute: g = κ V_disp c²/(2π r³)
Compare to conventional g = G m/r² to solve for G

derivations.name: Time from Shunt Counting
derivations.description: Time emerges as the count of shunt events, not as a fundamental dimension.
steps: Starting with velocity-frequency relationship: v = ν × λ_C
Express shunt count: N_shunts = ν × t

derivations.name: Pressure Field from CMB
derivations.description: Pressure field at any point receives contributions from CMB radiation, reduced by matter occlusion.
steps: CMB intensity is isotropic: I_CMB(î) = I_CMB = constant
For unobstructed space: Π₀ = ∫_Ω I_CMB dΩ = 4π I_CMB
Matter creates occlusion: ΔΠ(r) = -∫_Ω I_CMB E(r,î) dΩ
